transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Um... honestly, the thing that kind of scared me into coming in is that my eating has just been all over the place lately. Like, some days I'll completely forget to eat meals at all, and then other nights, I'm just tearing through takeout and snacks way past midnight. It's just really off for me, and I figured I needed to get it checked out.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or like you've lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean, I used to do a lot of stuff that I just... don't do anymore. Like, I used to play soccer on the weekends, and I'd cook dinner for my girlfriend. I even used to go check out these small art galleries sometimes, just for fun. And at work, I used to try and help out the newer sales guys, show them the ropes. But lately, I just... I can't make myself care about any of it. It's just too much effort.
How long have you been feeling this way—losing interest in things and finding it hard to care about your usual activities?

I'd say it's been about four months. The low mood, and... I guess just feeling guilty and not caring about things, it's been around for at least that long. It definitely got a lot harder to ignore after I had some trouble at work, though.
During those nights when you're eating a lot of takeout and snacks, do you feel like you can't stop or control how much you're eating, and does it leave you feeling upset or guilty afterward?

Um, no, I wouldn't say I feel out of control. It's not like I can't stop myself. I just... I guess I get really hungry because I forgot to eat earlier in the day, so I just order a bunch of food and eat it. I don't really feel upset or guilty about the eating itself afterward, either. It's just more annoying that my whole routine is so messed up right now.
Over these past four months, have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely been off. Um, most nights I just can't seem to fall asleep because my mind keeps running through my sales pitches. It just won't shut off. Or, if I do manage to get to sleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm goes off. And the weird thing is, I'll feel completely wired when I wake up, even though I know I barely slept at all.
Aside from the racing thoughts at night, have you noticed times recently where you felt unusually energetic, upbeat, or more talkative than normal, even without much sleep?

Yeah, I guess there are times like that. Like, some mornings I'll wake up feeling almost unbeatable, you know? Like I'm absolutely sure I can outsell everyone in the entire region. I just have this ton of energy. But then... I don't know, it flips really fast. Just one small comment from my manager or a client, and it sets me off way more than it should. I just get so irritated over nothing.
When you have those days of feeling unusually energetic and confident, how many days in a row does that usually last before your mood shifts back?

Well, it doesn't really shift back after a couple of days. Honestly, this whole episode has just been going on since the fight I had with my regional manager about a month ago. It's been pretty much constant since then.

On the days when you feel that surge of energy and confidence, are you also still feeling down, guilty, or uninterested in things at the same time, or does the low mood go away completely during those periods?

Um, no, I wouldn't say the low mood goes away completely. It's more like... I'll have all that energy and feel like I can take on the world, but underneath it, I still feel pretty awful. Like I'm just waiting for everything to fall apart. I still feel guilty about things, and I don't really care about the stuff I usually enjoy, even when I'm wired and talking a mile a minute. It's like both things are happening at the exact same time.
